{{Quote|Stand in place. On program. Feet down, face front, hands on heads. We will have immediate facility compliance or we will begin activating floors without warning.|The prison commander|<ref name="Nobody's Listening">{{Andor|Nobody's Listening!}}</ref>}}
A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] '''prison commander''' was an [[Imperial officer]] in the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex|Prison Complex]] on [[Narkina 5]]. He controlled numerous aspects of a [[Unidentified Imperial factory facility|Imperial factory facility]] in the prison complex including the PA system and the hydroelectric power plants, and was also in command of two technicians who controlled other aspects of the prison. During the [[Narkina 5 prison escape|uprising on Narkina 5]], he was forced at gunpoint by [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] and [[Kino Loy]] to disable the hydroelectric power plants.<ref name="One Way Out" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The prison commander first appeared through his voice in eighth episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]]," where he was credited as "Voice of God."<ref name="Narkina 5">{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}}</ref> He physically appeared in "[[One Way Out]]."<ref name="One Way Out" /> He was portrayed by [[Martin Ware]], the casting director of ''Andor''.
